projects.title: Calibration Verification and Accuracy Improvement of Ultra-Large-Scale Digital Array Antennas
summary: <u>Developed calibration and verification algorithms for ultra-large-scale digital array antennas (86,400+ elements) used in space surveillance radar,</u> addressing major error sources (probe phase center offset, polarization misalignment, position-dependent element beam patterns, 3D probe position uncertainty, and radome-induced channel distortion).

Designed an AI-integrated calibration verification simulator enabling independent and combined sensitivity analysis of error sources, providing quantitative performance evaluation and optimal calibration strategies for field-deployed large-aperture phased array systems.

projects.title: Large-Area Wireless Power Transfer System for Power Gateway Application
summary: Scaled up the LUT-based calibration and LCSPD architecture to a <u>1024-element (32×32) transmitter and 256-element (16×16) receiver array operating at 5.64 GHz for power gateway applications.</u>
Designed and validated high-power <u>WPT system operation exceeding 100 W transmitted power</u>, demonstrating the scalability of the proposed calibration and series power divider methodology.

projects.title: High-Efficiency BCE 2D Array RF System Based on Time Reversal
summary: Proposed an LUT-based calibration and complexity reduction method for <u>a scalable 256-element transmitter array</u> in RF wireless power transfer systems, enabling accurate beam collection efficiency (BCE) estimation using only a single input connection and a fixed reference antenna.

Designed a loss compensated series power divider (LCSPD) for scalable RF signal distribution and <u>demonstrated 71.9% BCE at 0.5 m with 6.08 W transmitted and 4.37 W received power at 5.64 GHz</u>, validated through convex-optimized near-field focusing experiments.
